speaker: Mike Lewis

zh: 这是在我们真正把它们当作聊天机器人之前。在我看来，它就像是你可以插入代码里的东西，用来管理边缘情况的怪异，选择一条路径，让你的应用继续运行。而且那时候上下文模型非常小。我在我的游戏电脑上本地运行这些东西。然后医疗记录公司开始打电话来，我建立起了这本客户业务，tier one 收购了我的公司。

speaker: Mike Lewis
en: Here's the only reason that's worth unpacking, is to say, I don't have this muddy, long history in the industry where I had opinions about everything or a solid way of thinking about it. speaker: Mike Lewis

speaker: Mike Lewis

speaker: Mike Lewis
en: I'm kind of skimming my screen here for the details on it. But basically, it was called Your New Job is to Onboard AI Agents, How AI Native Companies Actually Operate. And they just had this way of thinking through the L0 through L3. So I didn't invent that. I read it in that subject.

speaker: Mike Lewis
